hilbert_space: Complete charged Y_lm shells l<=2 times primitive spinhalf times complete neutral Y_LM shells L<=1 times complete three-oscillator number shells N<=1: 9*2*4*4=288. All these states enter H/G/current/contact/scattering and wavepacket propagation.
H0: Delta + Ic_inverse Lc^2/2 + In_inverse Ln^2/2 + lambda_c Lc dot S + lambda_n Ln dot S + u R_c dot R_n + omega Nfield. Products R_c dot R_n act on separate factors. Pure angular_geometry helper computes exact Galerkin multiplication and whole-shell rotation generators.
onsite_physical_rotations: J=Lc+S+Ln+Lfield generates simultaneous physical local sphere/orientor/vector rotations. H0 is invariant. The fixed cubic bond directions are a material frame, so the array is not fully SO3-invariant and J of internal factors is not by itself a global free-array Noether generator.
facing_contact: For bond d=a e_i define f_lm(d)=Y_lm(dhat); C_d=outer(conj(f(d)),f(-d))/sum|f(d)|^2. Ordinary orbital T=-t C_d. This is point-to-point shell contact, not a matrix selected in a jhalf basis. Full charged l=2 and all neutral states retained.
actual_material_fork: Two coherent parallel contact channels exchange facing order and have an opposite real path sign. T_interference=-t(C_d-C_d^dagger)/2. The relative pi sign is SUPPLIED material interference; not derived electromagnetism. Opposite signs remove same-parity hopping prior to diagonalization. Both geometries preserve inversion and time reversal.
dynamic_field: Use finite oscillator field_geometry helper's Q_i and N, with U_i=exp(-i q g a Q_i). Full T_i=(Torb_i tensor 1spin tensor 1neutral) tensor U_i. This is the literal finite-dimensional operator law, not exp projected from an unbounded oscillator, nor a derived spatial photon. No claim that truncated Q_i commute. Field is carried with the mobile object, not independent per-cell oscillators.
Bloch_H: H(k)=H0+sum_i [exp(i k dot d_i) T_i + exp(-i k dot d_i) T_i^dagger]. No energy subtraction or chemical adjustment is applied to H(k).
inversion: P=Pc tensor 1spin tensor Pn tensor (-1)^Nfield; P H(k) P=H(-k). Primitive spin is axial. Vector-potential Q is parity odd and time-reversal odd (field parity times complex conjugation). Combined PT has square -1: physical pair degeneracy is expected and desirable.
external_source_scope: EM probes resolve center/macrocells only: all internal angular/neutral/field states retained, but rho(q)=qcharge*1internal between center momenta. No intra-shell r phase, orbital magnetization/g2 or microscopic continuity on the shell is claimed. Charged shell radius remains the local angular length scale.
external_vertex: For kf-ki=qtransfer and km=(kf+ki)/2, J(eps)=i qcharge sum_i (eps dot d_i) sinc(qtransfer dot d_i/2) [exp(i km dot d_i)T_i-exp(-i km dot d_i)T_i^dagger]. Convention J=-dH(A)/dA for H(k-qcharge A). Uniform physical velocity=J/qcharge.
external_contact: C=d2H/dAout* dAin=-qcharge^2 sum_i (epsout* dot d_i)(epsin dot d_i) sinc(qin dot d_i/2)sinc(qout dot d_i/2)[exp(i km dot d_i)T_i+exp(-i km dot d_i)T_i^dagger], kf=ki+qin-qout.
spin_current: Js_i=(S_i J+J S_i)/2. Primitive spin need not be conserved because angular/neutral/field torque exchanges spin. Not a replacement by helicity or label splitting.
G: B creates every charged Y_lm spin state with neutral l0 and field vacuum out of declared empty charged N0 reference E0=0. G(k,z)=B^dagger(z-H(k))^-1 B, with all288 poles. This is addition-only charged propagation; no N2 intermediate, occupied-reference removal or positron reinterpretation.
interaction: Tfi=<f|C|i>+<f|Jout(Ei+omega-H(ki+qin)+i eta)^-1 Jin|i>+<f|Jin(Ei-omegaout-H(ki-qout)+i eta)^-1 Jout|i>. omegaout=omega+Ei-Ef uses actual recoil. Full angular/neutral/field intermediate spaces; external-source amplitude has no borrowed photon leg normalization.
feedback: At finite k use rest-low4 projector P and its full orthogonal complement Q. Sigma_P(z)=H_PQ(z-H_QQ)^-1 H_QP is actual same-H full virtual feedback; compare P(z-H)^-1P with (z-H_PP-Sigma)^-1 and with the unsupported Sigma=0 truncation. Supplied-field pole shifts/occupations compare same288-dimensional law at g=.22 and g=0.
Dirac_diagnostic_only: From actual four rest eigenstates compute velocities V_i=P(dH/dk_i)P, c^2=mean_i tr(V_i^2)/4, alpha_i=V_i/c, beta=diag((E_a-Ecenter)/m), Ecenter=mean(E_low4), m=(mean Eupper-mean Elower)/2. Test anticommutators, do not install matrices. Compare upper actual bands to Ecenter+sqrt(m^2+c^2p^2), and separately to sqrt(Eupper(0)^2+c^2p^2) using absolute N0 reference. No momentum-dependent center subtraction.
curvature_diagnosis: Band curvature for each doublet is average <n|d2H/dk_i2|n> plus average sum_m outside its exact degenerate subspace 2|<m|dH/dk_i|n>|^2/(En-Em). Report direct material and all-state virtual terms, scalar doublet-center curvature and gap/mass curvature separately. This resolves physical failure rather than fitting speed or reference.
units: hbar=radius=spacing=1; qcharge=-1, energies/frequencies fixed numerical inverse-inertia units; no electron constants fitted.
